BestAmusementParks

The world's best theme parks, from the historic fairgrounds that invented the form to the modern mega-resorts. The thing that decides your day is not the park but the queue: at the big US and Japanese resorts, arriving at opening buys you more rides before 11am than the entire afternoon will, and paid line-skipping has now been added on top of that at most of them.
